hooks.command:
OUTPUT=$(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/novel_check.py" 2>&1); EXIT=$?; echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] exit=$EXIT" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs/hook.log"; echo "$OUTPUT" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs/hook.log"; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then HARD=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -E '字数.*(❌|⚠)|SDT违禁|破折号.*>|重复句|重复段落|内部标记|motif密度.*超标|五感.*<3|比喻重复.*❌|情绪曲线.*❌|钩子.*❌' | head -15); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"全检未通过！硬伤：\n${HARD}\
请修复后再继续。\", \"continue\": true}"; else echo '{"systemMessage": "全检通过 ✅ | 提示：确认本章推进了规划中的事件单元，未偏离大纲。", "continue": true}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: 全量检查（正文+滑动窗口+流程文档）...
